description_html:
Key Features

  • Ferrite-Stage Induction Heating: Utilizes advanced ferrite-stage induction technology for efficient and uniform heating, ensuring precise temperature control throughout the bath.
  • High Peak Temperature: Achieves a maximum operating temperature of 1180°C, suitable for demanding industrial heat treatment and metallurgical processes.
  • Large Chamber Capacity: Offers a spacious chamber with a capacity of 1924 litres, accommodating large batches or oversized components for enhanced productivity.
  • Robust Cycle Endurance: Designed for long-term use with a durability rating of up to 3781 cycles before relining is required, minimizing maintenance interruptions.
  • Induction Heat Source: Employs a reliable induction heat source, providing rapid, energy-efficient heating with consistent performance.
  • Measured Heat-Up Time: Reaches peak temperature in 497 minutes, supporting predictable process scheduling and workflow planning.
  • Customizable Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific project requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Efficient Heat Treatment: Ideal for industries requiring high-temperature processing, such as metal fabrication, forging, and material testing, ensuring consistent results.
  • Enhanced Productivity: The large chamber size supports high-volume operations, reducing downtime and increasing throughput.
  • Long Service Life: High cycle endurance means fewer relining intervals, lowering maintenance costs and maximizing operational uptime.
  • Precise Temperature Management: Advanced induction technology delivers accurate and uniform heating, critical for quality control in sensitive applications.
  • Energy Savings: Induction heating offers improved energy efficiency compared to traditional heating methods, reducing operational expenses.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Industrial Heat Processing: Perfect for annealing, tempering, and hardening large metal parts or assemblies, meeting the needs of manufacturing plants and metallurgical facilities.
  • Research and Quality Assurance: Suitable for laboratory environments requiring consistent, repeatable high-temperature conditions for material testing or prototype development.
  • Bulk Processing Operations: Supports businesses seeking to process large quantities of materials in a single cycle, streamlining workflow and improving turnaround times.

Frequently Addressed User Needs

  • Durability: Built for longevity, with a high cycle rating to withstand frequent, intensive use.
  • Ease of Use: Straightforward operation with predictable heating profiles, aiding process planning and reducing the learning curve.
  • Compatibility: Designed for a wide range of industrial and laboratory applications where high-temperature, large-capacity induction baths are required.
  • Value: Flexible pricing ensures alignment with specific user requirements and budget constraints.

This ferrite-stage induction bath delivers high-capacity, high-temperature performance with reliable, energy-efficient operation—making it an optimal choice for demanding industrial and laboratory applications.
